title: Elder Rue Guardian
summary: The Elder Rue Guardian is the Casterwill family elder over curses and secrets. As the head of his house, he leads the other four Rue Guardians.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
When the [[Blue Star]] was activated, the Elder Rue Guardian and his house were among the representatives of the [[Casterwill family]] who met at the [[Fortress of Iron Will]]. Like [[Focauld Casterwill]], the Elder opposed the presence of [[Lok Lambert]] for not being a member of the family and voted against open confrontation with the [[Blood Spiral]]. {{source|Sophie on Trial}}

During the Blood Spiral's assault on the [[Fortress of Iron Will]], the [[Rue Guardians]] worked with [[Focauld Casterwill]] an ancient incantation, simultaneously invoking [[Coralgolem]], [[Feyone]], and [[Icarus]] Amulets within the stronghold. {{source|The Spiral War}}

sections.text:
Coralgolem — borrowed — Through an ancient ritual, the Guardians awoke the dormant Coralgolem within the Fortress of Iron Will to fight the Blood Spiral army.

Feyone x8 — borrowed — Through an ancient ritual, the Guardians awoke eight dormant Feyone statues within the Fortress of Iron Will to fight the Blood Spiral army.

full_text:
The Elder Rue Guardian is the Casterwill family elder over curses and secrets. As the head of his house, he leads the other four Rue Guardians.

== History ==
When the Blue Star was activated, the Elder Rue Guardian and his house were among the representatives of the Casterwill family who met at the Fortress of Iron Will. Like Focauld Casterwill, the Elder opposed the presence of Lok Lambert for not being a member of the family and voted against open confrontation with the Blood Spiral. [Sophie on Trial]

During the Blood Spiral's assault on the Fortress of Iron Will, the Rue Guardians worked with Focauld Casterwill an ancient incantation, simultaneously invoking Coralgolem, Feyone, and Icarus Amulets within the stronghold. [The Spiral War]

==Personality==
The Rue Guardian leads a mysterious and mostly silent order. Though Lok Lambert perceived him as potentially dark, Sophie Casterwill presumed that, by his familial association, he had good intentions. [Sophie on Trial]

==Abilities==
The Rue Guardian holds the secret knowledge of the Fortress of Iron Will and the Amulets hidden within. Together with the rest of his house, the Rue Guardians are capable of summoning an army of Titans from within the Fortress to their aid. [S2E40]
